profile.placement: same incumbent final formation; no paid placement
profile.opponent: current locked V3 with current conditional setup

candidate.funding: one point from nonpreferred physical axis if available, else Armor; preferred physical axis unchanged

training.disabledHeads: Empower 2 and 3 are fixed zero-effect heads; no extra observations
training.preflight: first 27 training boards, all four cases on both hosts, exact prior control traces
training.reuse: only exact matching prior plans with reconstructed input hashes; retain provenance
training.selection: whole-board internal validation; earliest recipe on ties; one refit then frozen

gates.independentUnit: offer board; both draft assignments and both physical seats
gates.primary: mean gain >=0.5 percentage points and positive whole-board bootstrap 95% lower bound
gates.confirmation: open only after qualification passes; same frozen model and gates; no replacement after opening
